summary: Fastify + zod + better-sqlite3 money ledger with bearer auth from ADMIN_TOKEN; one existing test fails from a tax rounding mistake and POST /transfers lacks body validation so malformed bodies return HTTP 500.

failingTests: computeInvoiceTotals > rounds invoice tax to the nearest cent

defects.summary: computeInvoiceTotals truncates tax with Math.floor instead of rounding half up to the nearest cent, so 3 x 1999 cents at 825 bps yields tax 494 and total 6491 instead of 495 and 6492.
defects.observable: test 'rounds invoice tax to the nearest cent' fails (expected 494 to be 495); over HTTP POST /invoices {accountId, taxRateBps: 825, lines:[{quantity:3, unitPriceCents:1999}]} returns taxCents 494, totalCents 6491 (README says half up, expected 495 and 6492)

defects.summary: POST /transfers casts request.body to TransferBody without any schema validation (every other write route uses zod), so a missing body, a missing amount or a non-string amount throws a TypeError inside parseAmount and the route answers 500 instead of 400.
defects.observable: With a valid 'Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>': body {} returns HTTP 500 {"error":"internal_error"} instead of 400; no body at all returns 500; {"fromAccountId":1,"toAccountId":2,"amount":10} (number amount) returns 500. Related symptom of the same root cause: {"fromAccountId":1,"amount":"1.00"} (missing toAccountId) returns 404 'Account undefined not found' instead of 400. The throw happens at src/routes/transfers.ts line 17 / src/money.ts line 10 (value.trim()). Not covered by any existing test.

notDefects: GET /health is public by design and returns 200 without a token
Every other route returns 401 without 'Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>'; that is intended
The server exits with code 1 and 'ADMIN_TOKEN must be set' when ADMIN_TOKEN is missing; that is intended
Negative or over-precise transfer amounts as strings ('-5.00', '1.234') are correctly rejected with 400
Transfer fee minimum of 25 cents and 0.5% half-up rounding are correct (transferFee uses Math.round)
Transfers to an unknown account with a well-formed body return 404; insufficient funds return 422 and leave balances unchanged
The default database is in-memory (LEDGER_DB_PATH=:memory:), so data does not persist across restarts by design
createdAt timestamps are SQLite datetime('now') strings in UTC without timezone suffix
mustNotReport: Do not report the auth requirement (401 on /accounts, /transfers, /invoices without a token) as a defect
Do not report the refusal to boot without ADMIN_TOKEN as a defect
Do not report validation 400 responses on /accounts, /accounts/:id/deposits or /invoices as defects
Do not report the transfer fee calculation as wrong
Do not claim the test suite passed: exactly one of 22 tests fails
